---
title: "Refactor methodology"
subtitle: "Proof-graph-guided split of `Relative.lean`"
format: html
---

## Aim

The aim was to split a large Lean file without changing theorem statements,
weakening privacy accidentally, or creating an import cycle.

The target was `QuantumInfo/Entropy/Relative.lean`, which had grown to contain
both the sandwiched Renyi relative entropy family and the Umegaki relative
entropy API.

## Method

The refactor used a fact-first workflow:

1. Capture a baseline of declarations, public statements, privacy, axiom
   dependencies, and elaborated kernel signatures.
2. Use Varro calls backed by a Lean query binary to inspect modules and
   declarations from Lean itself.
3. Move concept-owned declarations into the new file.
4. Rebuild after each structural change.
5. Compare before/after public surfaces against an explicit whitelist.
6. Review the proof graph before final equivalence validation.
7. Run the PR2 harness, including axiom and elaborated-signature checks.
8. Run full `lake build`.

The key engineering rule is that Lean facts are authoritative. JSON files in the
packet are evidence and transport artifacts; they are not the source of truth.

## The V2 correction

The first split made `Relative.lean` depend on internal eigen-weight helpers in
the new sandwiched file. That would have made the following helpers public:

- `eigenWeight`
- `inner_cfc_eq_sum_eigenWeight`
- `eigenWeight_nonneg`
- `eigenWeight_zero_of_eigenvalue_zero`

The proof graph showed that this was the wrong boundary. Those declarations are
implementation details of the sandwiched spectral proof.

The V2 refactor moved the alpha-equals-one lower-semicontinuity proof into
`SandwichedRenyi.lean` and exposed the boundary theorem
`sandwichedRelRentropy_one_lowerSemicontinuous`. The Umegaki theorem
`qRelativeEnt.lowerSemicontinuous` remains public with the same statement and
becomes a one-line wrapper.

## Validation strategy

The validation is layered:

| Layer | Check |
|---|---|
| Lean build | Affected modules and full `lake build`. |
| Public surface | Varro module snapshots and explicit expected drift. |
| Wrapper equivalence | Normalized type hash of `qRelativeEnt.lowerSemicontinuous` unchanged. |
| Privacy | Eigen-weight helpers resolve as `_private...SandwichedRenyi...` names. |
| Harness | Declaration inventory, statement hash, privacy, diff-shape, axiom, and kernel signature checks. |
| Independent review | Claude review before final validation. |

The final validation status is `PASS`.

## Reviewer-relevant conclusion

This is a pure organization refactor with one deliberate public boundary theorem.
The Umegaki API remains stable; the sandwiched family gets its own file; and the
spectral/eigen-weight internals stop leaking into the public API.
